title: NewOrganizationWebhookEndpoint

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the endpoint was created, in RFC 3339 format.

description.title: Description
description.description: Notes about the endpoint. An empty string when none were given.

disabled_reason.title: Disabled Reason
disabled_reason.description: Why Anthropic disabled the endpoint automatically. An empty string when the endpoint is enabled, or when you disabled it.

enabled_events.title: Enabled Events
enabled_events.description: The event types delivered to the endpoint.

name.title: Name
name.description: A short label for the endpoint. An empty string when none was given.

signing_secret.title: Signing Secret
signing_secret.description: The secret Anthropic signs deliveries to the endpoint with (prefix `whsec_`). No other response returns it, so store it now. To replace it, regenerate the signing secret.

state.description: Whether deliveries are sent to the endpoint.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the endpoint was last changed, in RFC 3339 format.

url.title: Url
url.description: The HTTPS URL that deliveries are sent to.

description: A new organization webhook endpoint, with its signing secret.
